Ex-Pak Minister Threatens India

Former Pakistani Home Minister Sheikh Rasheed Ahmed has been caught on video calling himself a servant of Hafiz Saeed, the founder of Lashkar-e-Taiba. In the video, he threatens India with a 'paav bhar ke atom bomb' (an atom bomb the size of a fist). The video has surfaced on social media, showing Ahmed sharing a stage with people linked to Lashkar-e-Taiba and praising Hafiz Saeed. The former minister also claims that the bell at Birla Temple will not ring. The video has sparked controversy, with some outlets framing it as a revelation of Pakistan's true intentions.
